# Constants (edit everything here)
```{r define-constants}
# Top genes taken from each ranking (GPS and HVG dispersion)
TOP_N <- 100

# Violin plots
VIOLIN_N    <- 8   # first N genes (rank order) per gene set
VIOLIN_NCOL <- 4   # panels per row

# Directories
INPUT_DIR <- here("Filtered_Input")
GENE_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "Gene_Scores")   # written by Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd
OUT_DIR   <- here("Violin_Plots")      # <OUT_DIR>/<name>_<set>_Violin_Plot.tif/.jpg

# Plot appearance
PLOT_DPI    <- 300
PLOT_WIDTH  <- 5   # inches (1500 x 1200 px at 300 dpi)
PLOT_HEIGHT <- 4

# Datasets to run: name (prefix from the extraction Rmd) = counts CSV filename
# Comment out a line to skip that dataset
datasets <- c(
    Azimuth_MMC                = "Azimuth_MMC_Counts.csv"  # first entry: don't comment out
  , Human_Intestines           = "Human_Intestines_subset_counts.csv"
  , Mouse_Heart                = "Mouse_Heart_subset_counts.csv"
  , PBMCs                      = "PBMCs_Counts.csv"
  , TabulaMuris_Liver          = "TabulaMuris_Liver_Counts.csv"
  , Human_CRC                  = "Human_CRC_subset_counts.csv"
  , Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex = "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex.csv"
  , PBMC12K                    = "PBMC12K_Counts.csv"
  , Pollen                     = "Pollen_TPM_Matrix.csv"
  , TabulaMuris_Lung           = "TabulaMuris_Lung_Counts.csv"
)
```

# Functions
## Loading
```{r define-functions-loading}
# Read a counts CSV and standardize gene/cell names (same scheme as the extraction Rmd)
load_dataset <- function(path) {
  counts <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(counts) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(counts))
  colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))
  counts
}

# Normalize with Seurat (log-normalize, scale factor 10,000)
normalize_counts <- function(counts) {
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(counts))
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- "All_Cells"
  NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
}

gene_score_path <- function(name) {
  file.path(GENE_DIR, paste0(name, "_gene_scores.csv"))
}

# 0 means "dropped by PG filters / not scored by Seurat" -> NA
read_gene_scores <- function(name) {
  gs <- read.csv(gene_score_path(name), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  gs$GPS[gs$GPS == 0]                       <- NA
  gs$HVG_Dispersion[gs$HVG_Dispersion == 0] <- NA
  gs
}

# Top n gene names by a score, descending, ignoring NA
top_genes <- function(values, genes, n = TOP_N) {
  keep <- !is.na(values)
  names(head(sort(setNames(values[keep], genes[keep]), decreasing = TRUE), n))
}

# Split PG and HVG lists into PG-only / HVG-only / intersect
# (intersect keeps PG rank order)
build_violin_sets <- function(pg_genes, hvg_genes) {
  common <- intersect(pg_genes, hvg_genes)
  list(PG_Only        = setdiff(pg_genes,  common),
       HVG_Only       = setdiff(hvg_genes, common),
       INTERSECT_Only = common)
}
```

## Plotting and saving
```{r define-functions-plots}
# Save a plot as TIFF and JPG: <out_dir>/<name>_<suffix>.tif/.jpg
save_plot <- function(plot, out_dir, name, suffix,
                      width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  stem <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_", suffix))

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# Seurat feature names for the first VIOLIN_N genes of a ranked list, dropping
# any not in the Seurat object. Seurat stores features with "-" instead of "_".
violin_features <- function(norm_obj, genes, label) {
  genes    <- head(genes, VIOLIN_N)
  features <- gsub("_", "-", genes)
  found    <- features %in% rownames(norm_obj)
  if (any(!found)) {
    warning(label, ": ", sum(!found), " of the first ", VIOLIN_N,
            " genes not in the Seurat object and left out: ",
            paste(genes[!found], collapse = ", "))
  }
  features[found]
}

# Violin plot of the given features (no points)
make_violin_plot <- function(norm_obj, features) {
  VlnPlot(norm_obj, features = features, ncol = VIOLIN_NCOL, pt.size = 0) &
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")
}
```

## Full pipeline for one dataset
```{r define-functions-pipeline}
run_dataset <- function(name, counts_path) {
  gs        <- read_gene_scores(name)
  pg_genes  <- top_genes(gs$GPS,            gs$Gene)
  hvg_genes <- top_genes(gs$HVG_Dispersion, gs$Gene)
  sets      <- build_violin_sets(pg_genes, hvg_genes)

  norm_obj <- normalize_counts(load_dataset(counts_path))

  for (set_name in names(sets)) {
    features <- violin_features(norm_obj, sets[[set_name]], paste(name, set_name))
    if (!length(features)) {
      message(name, ": no genes for ", set_name, " violin plot; skipped")
      next
    }

    p <- make_violin_plot(norm_obj, features)
    print(p)
    save_plot(p, OUT_DIR, name, paste0(set_name, "_Violin_Plot"))
    message(name, ": ", set_name, " plotted with ", length(features), " genes")
  }

  invisible(lengths(sets))
}
```

# Run all datasets
```{r run-all}
# Check all input files exist before starting
needed <- c(file.path(INPUT_DIR, datasets),
            gene_score_path(names(datasets)))
missing <- needed[!file.exists(needed)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing input files:\n  ", paste(missing, collapse = "\n  "),
       "\n(Gene score files come from Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd.)")
}

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

status <- character(0)

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  status[name] <- tryCatch({
    run_dataset(name, file.path(INPUT_DIR, datasets[[name]]))
    "success"
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  gc()  # free the dense count matrix before the next dataset
}

# Summary
failed <- status[status != "success"]
if (length(failed)) {
  message("Failed datasets:")
  for (n in names(failed)) message("  ", n, ": ", failed[[n]])
} else {
  message("All ens", length(status), " datasets completed.")
}
```
